text:
maya: Quick sync — drafting internal release note for Tue 22:00 UTC change window. Please drop one-line team bullets in the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/release/2026-03-22-draft.

dan: added the CLI pin commands + model pin: embedder-v1.9.0 (pinned, no auto-update). Also added fallback to cpu-quant v1.8.

raj: I'll take rollback procedures and canary pass criteria. planning 15m canary + health checks: 5xx rate and p95 latency.

ops-oncall: Ops asks for a freeze for customer docs and UI from 21:30-23:30 UTC. Also include APAC handoff note at 23:10 UTC.

deploybot: [deploy-bot] Plan: canary at 22:00 UTC -> steady. Playbook: /runbooks/releases/2026-03-22. Canary 15m. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.8% for 10m OR p95 up by >1.5s for 10m. Alerts to #incidents and #eng-oncall.

maya: thanks. commms @commms can you craft the internal blurb once team snippets are in? Keep it one short paragraph + bullets.

commms: yes, i'll draft the blurb. need exact wording for billing change and API rename.

dan: billing change line: "billing metric: token-usage now reports compute-token and storage-token separately (no customer cost change)". API rename: param 'max_new_tokens' -> 'max_generated'.

support: we'll need a 3-line FAQ for support. ping us before the pin.

raj: rollback steps added to doc. simple: stop ramp, pin previous model, revert routing, scale down. added sample commands.

ops-oncall: reserve dedicated capacity for first hour post-deploy. if pool utilization < 90% during ramp hold and investigate.

maya: timeline: add snippets by 16:30 UTC, comms will finalize by 17:15 UTC, i'll pin in channel at 17:30 UTC with deploybot cue. ack?

dan: ack.

raj: ack.

ops-oncall: ack.

support: ack.

commms: ack, i'll have the blurb ready.

maya: great, thanks everyone. i'll pin the final note + deploybot schedule at 17:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
